rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a powered drilling tool.

example.english: Could you lend me a drill?
example.jyutping: ze3 baa2 din6 zyun3 bei2 ngo5 dak1 m4 dak1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for making a hole with a drill.

example.english: I used an electric drill to drill a hole in the wall.
example.traditional: 我用電鑽喺牆上鑽個窿。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 din6 zyun1 hai2 coeng4 soeng6 zyun1 go3 lung1

rows.note: Use this when repeatedly impressing an idea or principle on someone so they remember it.

example.english: Mum uses repetition to drill into us that we should rely on ourselves.
example.traditional: 阿媽由細到大都灌輸我哋要靠自己。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 jau4 sai3 dou3 daai6 dou1 gun3 syu1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kaau3 zi6 gei2

rows.note: Use this for repeated practice or training, especially for military routines or disciplined performance.

example.english: The unit has to drill every morning.
example.traditional: 部隊每日朝早都要操練。
example.jyutping: bou6 deoi6 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 jiu3 cou1 lin6

rows.note: Use this for a general practice exercise rather than a formal simulated operation.

example.english: I do English drill every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 zou6 jing1 man4 lin6 zaap6

rows.note: Use this for repeated or disciplined training, especially military drill.

example.english: The new recruits have to do military drill every morning.
example.traditional: 新兵每日朝早都要操練。
example.jyutping: san1 bing1 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 jiu3 cou1 lin6

rows.note: Use this for an organized simulated exercise such as a fire drill or emergency drill.

example.english: The firefighters will hold a fire drill next week.
example.traditional: 消防員下個星期會做火警演習。
example.jyutping: siu1 fong4 jyun4 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 wui5 zou6 fo2 ging2 jin2 zaap6
